The '''Untamed''' were a group of isolationist people living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="Onslaught" /> who were supposedly descended from the ancient [[Beast Riders]].<ref name="TOR-TUC" />

==Description==
The Untamed were strictly isolationist and ritualistic, having a severe disgust for offworlders. Despite that, they tolerated anyone who respected their ceremonies or bested them in combat, but only temporarily.<ref name="TOR-TUC" /> The Untamed were led by the [[Beast-Lord]]s.

==History==
The Untamed were, according to their leader [[Akoru]], descendants of the ancient [[Beast Riders]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] who were [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] to the wilderness by an outsider, namely the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. They continued the tradition of inhabiting Onderon's [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], taming wild beasts such as the [[pritarr]]s, and passing along fierce combat abilities.<ref name="TOR-TUC" /> Eventually, the Untamed seized the [[Proving Grounds|Ancient Proving Grounds]] built by Freedon Nadd [[Naddist|cultists]], using the site for Beast-Lord trials.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Ancient Proving Grounds}}</ref>

In [[3627 BBY]], during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the war arrived on Onderon. Imperial forces under [[Darth Savik]] landed secretly on the planet and were able to convince the Untamed to attack the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].
